correctness.rationale: The zero-square polynomial has scalar obstruction and split hyperbolic form Q(a,b)=a∧b. Maximal totally singular subspaces are exactly (U,alternating β), all dimension 3 modulo the one-dimensional radical; counting gives 4 strata. Polarization annihilates cubic cross products, yielding W²=Λ²U and closure iff dim U≤2. Intrinsic radical filtration and explicit inner conjugation prove 4 automorphism orbits. The projective coordinate map proves exact PG3 point–hyperplane incidence; full split-orthogonal transitivity and double counting prove containment degree 2(q+1). Standalone code independently exhausts 33,880 3-subspaces at q=3 and tests all constructed q=3,5 cases. Finite checks corroborate, do not replace general proof.

value.rationale: The three-generator exterior algebra is canonical; elementwise square-zero differs substantially from pairwise annihilation. The theorem identifies all maximal linear spaces of square-zero elements and exactly separates genuine noncommutative associative subalgebras from nonclosed spaces, with four intrinsic automorphism strata and complete projective-incidence/containment data. This is a natural complete classification rather than an unmotivated cutoff or computation.
